name: What does general contractor project management include for a home remodel?

mainEntity.name: What does general contractor project management include for a home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: General contractor project management covers the complete oversight of a remodel from initial planning through final walkthrough. Instead of a homeowner coordinating multiple independent workers, the GC oversees daily jobsite operations, material schedules, and quality control. At HH Remodeling LLC, owner Abraham Becerra serves as the direct on-site lead and single point of contact. While our internal crew directly handles carpentry, tile, drywall, framing, and interior painting, we schedule and manage specialized trade partners for plumbing and electrical work. This structure ensures trade tasks occur in the proper sequence without leaving gaps in accountability.
acceptedAnswer.description: GC project management oversees full remodel scheduling, material deliveries, on-site labor, and trade coordination from initial planning to completion under a single point of contact.
